test_title: PYST 26: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 20th Sep 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the sentence containing the homonym of the highlighted word:

He could not **lead** the expedition successfully.

options.text: The pipes were made of lead.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"lead"** has two meanings:
 
 
• Meaning 1: To guide or direct others, often being in charge. (नेतृत्व करना)
 
 
• **Example:** He will lead the team to success.
 
 
• Meaning 2: A heavy, soft, malleable metal, symbolized as Pb in the periodic table. (सीसा)
 
 
• **Example:** The pipes were made of lead.
 
 
 
 
• The word **"lead"** in the sentence "He could not lead the expedition successfully" refers to the act of guiding or being in charge. (नेतृत्व करना)
 
• The sentence in Option 1, "The pipes were made of lead," uses the word "lead" as a reference to the metal (सीसा), which is the homonym of "lead" (नेतृत्व करना).

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2: She leads the orchestra.** (वह ऑर्केस्ट्रा का नेतृत्व करती है।)
 
 
• This refers to the act of guiding or directing, not the homonym of "lead" (सीसा).
 
• **Example:** She leads the orchestra with great skill.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: Leadership skills were discussed.** (नेतृत्व कौशल पर चर्चा की गई।)
 
 
• This refers to the concept of leading or being in charge, not the homonym of "lead" (सीसा).
 
• **Example:** Leadership skills are essential for managing a team.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: He will lead tomorrow.** (वह कल नेतृत्व करेगा।)
 
 
• This refers to guiding or directing, not the homonym of "lead" (सीसा).
 
• **Example:** He will lead tomorrow's meeting.
 
 

3d:Tede,
The correct answer is '**Option 2**'.
